content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The notification announces a total of 3 vacancies under the GOI scheme "Mission Shakti". Here is the post-wise breakdown:

content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant should be a permanent resident of UT Ladakh.

rows.qualification_required: i. Any women having a Master in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Science/Psychology with at least 5 years experience of working on women related relevant domains in an administrative set-up with a Government or Non-Government project/programme and preferably with at least 1-year experience of counselling either within or outside the same set-up. ii. She should be preferably a resident of the local community so that local human resource and expertise is utilized for effective functioning of the centre.

Person having at least 2 years experience of working as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district/state level. He/She should preferably be retired military/para-military personnel.

content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Age Limit
content_sections.text: The applicant should not be below 18 years as on 01.01.2026. The notification does not mention an upper age limit.

content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Salary
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated on a monthly contractual basis for a period of 06 months.

content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of all academic/technical qualification certificates Certificate of required experience Certificate of proof of Residence for UT Ladakh Prescribed affidavit duly executed/sworn before a Judicial Magistrate regarding absorption/regularization in the UT Govt. at any latter stage (upon selection)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LAHDC Leh Recruitment
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the District Programme Office, ICDS Projects Leh. Fill out the separate application form for each post if applying for multiple posts. Attach self-attested photocopies of academic/technical qualifications, experience certificates, and proof of residence for UT Ladakh. Ensure the application is complete in all respects. Submit the duly completed application form by hand in the office of District Programme Office, ICDS Projects, Leh on or before 17th of October, 2026 till 4:30 P.M.

content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify detailed selection stages beyond evaluation of required qualifications, experience, and application scrutiny by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: LAHDC Leh Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant should be a permanent resident of UT Ladakh. The applicant should have the requisite qualification for which he/she has applied. The applicant should have a good moral character. The applicant should not be below 18 years as on 01.01.2026. Incomplete applications shall be rejected without assigning any reason thereof. Application forms received after the cutoff date shall not be entertained in any case. The engagement is temporary for F.Y. 2026-27 up to 31st March 2027 and no claims for extension or regularization shall be made by any candidate. Candidates upon selection must execute an affidavit before a Judicial Magistrate stating that they have no claim for permanent absorption/regularization in UT Govt. at any later stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is LAHDC Leh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: LAHDC Leh Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive announced via advertisement number 67-DPOL of 2026 to fill 3 temporary contractual vacancies for Central Administrator and Guard under the Mission Shakti scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under LAHDC Leh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies: 1 vacancy for Central Administrator (One Stop Centre) and 2 vacancies for Guard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for LAHDC Leh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit application forms is 17 October 2026 till 4:30 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Central Administrator?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master degree in Law, Social Work, Sociology, Science, or Psychology with at least 5 years of experience in women-related relevant domains in an administrative setup with a Government or Non-Government project, preferably with at least 1-year counselling experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Guard post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have at least 2 years of experience as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district or state level, preferably as retired military or paramilitary personnel.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for LAHDC Leh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be below 18 years of age as on 01.01.2026. An upper age limit is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for LAHDC Leh Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for LAHDC Leh posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must obtain the application form from the District Programme Office, ICDS Projects Leh, fill it out, attach required self-attested documents, and submit it by hand at the same office before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is strictly temporary on a contract basis for a period of 6 months up to 31st March 2027, and candidates must submit an affidavit stating they have no right to permanent absorption or regularization.

faq.question: Q10. What is the monthly remuneration for these posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 33,100/- for Central Administrator and Rs. 7,944/- for Guard.
